verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a hardware accelerator with no end-user interface of its own, so surfacing AI-generated insights from a user's data 'inside the product' is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence offers only developer building blocks: RAPIDS/cuDF/cuML acceleration, NIM models and the CUDA toolkit for building AI workloads. None of it shows the GPU itself delivering in-product insights, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.
